title: THING//MANIA - Demo Mix
description: Short, punchy arrangement for a hackathon demo video: a cold open (one full-band hit with the ding, then the toaster sings its tag at double speed into the silence and the snare picks up), the 16-bar main theme, and a real ending (the battery sag lands on a final E hit with the ding, the whistle swoop and the choir). 18 bars and the decay of the ending, exactly 41.0 s (the mix is below -70 dBFS from 40.6 s). Section starts for editing: theme 2.2625 s, appliances 11.3125 s, development 20.3625 s, hook return 29.4125 s, ending 38.4625 s.

tracks.description: A's squelch bass riff (AC-01's sound, choke and processing).
Parallel high-passed, driven copy of the bass so the riff carries on phone speakers.
A's whistle: hook, pickups and bends, with its dotted-eighth echo.
The same whistle without the echo, for phrases that hand straight over to an appliance or a hit.
A second whistler a sixth under the hook in the return (bars 13 and 15), opposite the lead.
Rootless clav stabs on the swung off-beats; they step aside whenever an appliance sings.
A's kick, locked to the bass.
Parallel crunch bus: the kick and snare hits again, high-passed and driven hard so the kit reads on phones.
Swung 16ths accenting the off-beat eighths; open hat on 4-and, choked by the next closed hat.
C's rice-jar shaker opposite the hats from the development on, and spoon-on-pot-lid on the backbeat in the hook return.
The lead appliance (toaster): the ba-da-DEE tag riding the bass bend.
The kettle: the tag a fourth below the toaster.
Close-harmony appliance choir: hits, the return chord and the battery sag.
Kitchen FX: the E7 timer ding (power restored) and the kettle coming to the boil.
